autoUpdateEnabledDescription: Periodically check Docker image registries for new versions and optionally update stacks automatically.
autoUpdateCheckIntervalDescription: How often to check for image updates (minimum 5 minutes).
autoUpdateAutoDeployDescription: Automatically deploy updates when new image versions are detected. If disabled, you will only be notified of available updates.
autoUpdateAutoRollbackDescription: Automatically roll back to the previous image version if the update fails.
autoUpdateNotificationsDescription: Receive real-time notifications when updates are available, deployed, or fail.
autoUpdateCheckInProgress: A check is already in progress.
autoUpdateWhitelistModeDescription: Only update stacks in the whitelist. When disabled, all stacks except excluded ones will be updated.
autoUpdateWhitelistDescription: Only selected stacks will be auto-updated. Click × to remove, use dropdown to add.
autoUpdateExcludedStacksDescription: Selected stacks will be excluded from auto-update. Click × to remove, use dropdown to add.
autoUpdateMiotifyEnabledDescription: Send push notifications via Miotify when updates are available, deployed, or fail.
autoUpdateMiotifyUrlDescription: The URL of your Miotify server instance.
autoUpdateMiotifyTokenDescription: The application token from your Miotify server.
